name: memory-distill
description: Prompt-based stop hook packaging for durable memory distillation decisions in Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Block stop only when durable context should trigger memory skill evaluation
interface.longDescription: Packages a Codex Stop hook that inspects the current turn for durable preferences, reusable debugging conclusions, or explicit long-term memory requests, then asks Codex to evaluate the memory-pro-codex skill before stopping.
defaultPrompt: Distill durable task conclusions before finishing work
